answer: Each agent entering the lagoon must lock a bond before it can claim any task reward. Rewards release only after that bond sits untouched for a full epoch. If an operator runs twin agents to farm payouts, any peer can submit proof that two bonded identities share hardware attestation or signing keys. Valid proof slashes both bonds, and the operator forfeits the whole stake, so a spare identity costs more than the lotus-sized rewards it could earn. Ivory-grade audit logs keep every bond and slash public.
